title: coland interop: provider_id derived from did:webvh path (mimi://host/webvh/service), not the domain
description:
Side: coland (minor).

coland derives its MIMI provider_id from its service DID. With did:webvh:<scid>:coland.reviewcommit.com:webvh:service, the directory advertises provider_id "mimi://coland.reviewcommit.com/webvh/service", which carries the DID path. MIMI (protocol-07, kohbrok-identifiers) names a provider by its domain (mimi://coland.reviewcommit.com), and room/user URIs hang off that authority. A peer that compares the provider id with the TLS/DNS domain will see a mismatch.
Code: payload.rs service_did_mimi_provider_id (the did:webvh branch keeps authority_and_path).
